title: East Boulevard filmed assault involving Di-Quan Schafar Hunt

data.name: East Boulevard filmed assault
data.description: Charlotte-Mecklenburg police and local reporting identified Di-Quan Schafar Hunt as the suspect in a July 30, 2026 assault recorded on social media. Reporting says a woman was punched on the sidewalk and suffered serious but non-life-threatening injuries. Victim identity intentionally omitted.

title: Evidence: July 30 assault captured on social media video

data.claim: WBTV, citing Charlotte-Mecklenburg police, reported that a social-media video showed Hunt punch a woman on an East Boulevard sidewalk on July 30, 2026; police arrested Hunt on Aug. 6.

title: Evidence: victim suffered serious non-life-threatening injuries

data.claim: Investigators said the woman suffered serious but non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Historical evidence: at least nine arrests from October 2023 through December 2025

data.claim: WBTV reported that arrest records show Hunt was arrested at least nine times from October 2023 through December 2025, with charges including assault with a deadly weapon, communicating threats, assault on a female, and domestic-violence-order violations.
data.notes: This record counts arrests, not convictions; the nine events were not individually reconstructed from official dockets in this pass.

title: Historical evidence: March 2026 plea and 89 days time served for December 2025 incident

data.claim: WBTV reported that Hunt pleaded on March 18, 2026 to assault with a deadly weapon and carrying a concealed weapon from a December 2025 incident, was sentenced to time served after 89 days in jail, and was released the day of sentencing.
